$comment: Declared budgets for the 60-image Atlas performance profile (ATLAS-WRITER-MASS-BUILD-001L). Wall-clock milliseconds as measured by the harness through a real Chromium against a Vite dev server on a laptop; generous on purpose so a breach is a regression, not noise. `notes_save` includes the UI's own save debounce (SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS). Breaching a budget fails the `performance` stage and never weakens a correctness stage.
